shortDescription.text: Each accesskey value must be unique.

fullDescription.text: Each accesskey value must be unique. A best-practice check that no success criterion requires.

help.text: Give every element that has an accesskey its own key. No suggested edit: Which element keeps the key, and what the others use, is the author's decision.

properties.noFixReason: Which element keeps the key, and what the others use, is the author's decision.

shortDescription.text: An area element of an image map that is a link must have alternative text.

fullDescription.text: An area element of an image map that is a link must have alternative text. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context) (level A, WCAG 2.0); 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Add an alt attribute to the area that says where the link goes. No suggested edit: The name is content: only the author knows what the element is called or shows.

properties.noFixReason: The name is content: only the author knows what the element is called or shows.

shortDescription.text: Each WAI-ARIA state or property on an element must be one that the element's role supports.

fullDescription.text: Each WAI-ARIA state or property on an element must be one that the element's role supports. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Remove the attribute, or give the element the role that supports it. No suggested edit: The attribute may be right and the role wrong (or the reverse); choosing between changing the role and dropping the attribute is a judgement.

properties.noFixReason: The attribute may be right and the role wrong (or the reverse); choosing between changing the role and dropping the attribute is a judgement.

shortDescription.text: The role attribute of an element should be one that ARIA in HTML allows on that element.

fullDescription.text: The role attribute of an element should be one that ARIA in HTML allows on that element. A best-practice check that no success criterion requires.

help.text: Remove the role, or use an element that suits the role. No suggested edit: Changing the role changes what the element means to users, and which meaning is intended is the author's call.

properties.noFixReason: Changing the role changes what the element means to users, and which meaning is intended is the author's call.

shortDescription.text: aria-braillelabel needs an accessible name and aria-brailleroledescription needs an aria-roledescription to refine.

fullDescription.text: aria-braillelabel needs an accessible name and aria-brailleroledescription needs an aria-roledescription to refine. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Add the ordinary label or role description that the braille text abbreviates. No suggested edit: The missing text is content, which only the author can supply.

properties.noFixReason: The missing text is content, which only the author can supply.

shortDescription.text: A button, link or menu item given its role by the role attribute must have an accessible name.

fullDescription.text: A button, link or menu item given its role by the role attribute must have an accessible name. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Give the control a visible text label, an aria-label or an aria-labelledby. No suggested edit: The name is content: only the author knows what the control is called.

properties.noFixReason: The name is content: only the author knows what the control is called.

shortDescription.text: A native checkbox must not carry an aria-checked value that disagrees with its checked state.

fullDescription.text: A native checkbox must not carry an aria-checked value that disagrees with its checked state. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Drop aria-checked and let the checked attribute carry the state. Suggested edit: Remove aria-checked from a native checkbox whose value disagrees with the checked attribute. The native state is the one assistive technology reports.

properties.fix: Remove aria-checked from a native checkbox whose value disagrees with the checked attribute. The native state is the one assistive technology reports.

shortDescription.text: The role that applies to an element must not be one that WAI-ARIA or its digital publishing module has deprecated.

fullDescription.text: The role that applies to an element must not be one that WAI-ARIA or its digital publishing module has deprecated. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Replace the deprecated role with the role the specification recommends in its place. Suggested edit: Replace the role directory with list, the replacement WAI-ARIA 1.2 names.

properties.fix: Replace the role directory with list, the replacement WAI-ARIA 1.2 names.

shortDescription.text: A dialog or alert dialog given its role by the role attribute should have an accessible name.

fullDescription.text: A dialog or alert dialog given its role by the role attribute should have an accessible name. A best-practice check that no success criterion requires.

help.text: Name the dialog with aria-labelledby pointing at its title, or with aria-label. No suggested edit: The name is content: only the author knows what the control is called.

properties.noFixReason: The name is content: only the author knows what the control is called.

shortDescription.text: The body element must not have aria-hidden="true", which hides the whole page from assistive technology.

fullDescription.text: The body element must not have aria-hidden="true", which hides the whole page from assistive technology. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (level A, WCAG 2.0); 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Remove aria-hidden from body; hide only the parts of the page that need hiding. Suggested edit: Remove aria-hidden="true" from body. No reading of the page is served by hiding all of it.

properties.fix: Remove aria-hidden="true" from body. No reading of the page is served by hiding all of it.

shortDescription.text: An element with aria-hidden="true" must not contain anything that can receive focus through the Tab key.

fullDescription.text: An element with aria-hidden="true" must not contain anything that can receive focus through the Tab key. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Make the hidden content non-focusable (tabindex="-1" or disabled), or stop hiding it. No suggested edit: Hiding it from assistive technology, making it unfocusable and showing it are three different outcomes, and the author must choose.

properties.noFixReason: Hiding it from assistive technology, making it unfocusable and showing it are three different outcomes, and the author must choose.

shortDescription.text: A combo box, list box, search box, slider, spin button or text box given its role by the role attribute must have an accessible name.

fullDescription.text: A combo box, list box, search box, slider, spin button or text box given its role by the role attribute must have an accessible name. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Label the field with a visible label, aria-label or aria-labelledby. No suggested edit: The name is content: only the author knows what the control is called.

properties.noFixReason: The name is content: only the author knows what the control is called.

shortDescription.text: A meter given its role by the role attribute must have an accessible name.

fullDescription.text: A meter given its role by the role attribute must have an accessible name. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 1.1.1 Non-text Content (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Say what the meter measures with aria-label or aria-labelledby. No suggested edit: The name is content: only the author knows what the control is called.

properties.noFixReason: The name is content: only the author knows what the control is called.

shortDescription.text: A progress bar given its role by the role attribute must have an accessible name.

fullDescription.text: A progress bar given its role by the role attribute must have an accessible name. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 1.1.1 Non-text Content (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Say what is progressing with aria-label or aria-labelledby. No suggested edit: The name is content: only the author knows what the control is called.

properties.noFixReason: The name is content: only the author knows what the control is called.

shortDescription.text: A WAI-ARIA attribute must not be used on a role that prohibits it, such as aria-label on an element with no role.

fullDescription.text: A WAI-ARIA attribute must not be used on a role that prohibits it, such as aria-label on an element with no role. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Remove the attribute, or give the element a role that can be named. No suggested edit: The attribute may be a name or state meant for another element or role, so whether to remove it, move it or change the role depends on what the author meant.

properties.noFixReason: The attribute may be a name or state meant for another element or role, so whether to remove it, move it or change the role depends on what the author meant.

shortDescription.text: An element with an explicit role must set the states and properties that role requires.

fullDescription.text: An element with an explicit role must set the states and properties that role requires. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Add the required attribute with a value that matches the element's state. No suggested edit: The value of a required state (checked, the current value of a slider) is the page's own data, so the library cannot choose it.

properties.noFixReason: The value of a required state (checked, the current value of a slider) is the page's own data, so the library cannot choose it.

shortDescription.text: An element whose role needs owned elements (a list needs items, a table needs rows) must contain them.

fullDescription.text: An element whose role needs owned elements (a list needs items, a table needs rows) must contain them. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Add the required child elements, or use a role that needs none. No suggested edit: Adding rows, items or options is content, and wrapping existing children can change the page's structure, so the right edit is the author's.

properties.noFixReason: Adding rows, items or options is content, and wrapping existing children can change the page's structure, so the right edit is the author's.

shortDescription.text: An element whose role needs a parent role (a list item needs a list, a tab needs a tab list) must be inside one.

fullDescription.text: An element whose role needs a parent role (a list item needs a list, a tab needs a tab list) must be inside one. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Put the element inside an element with the required role, or use a role that needs no parent. No suggested edit: Wrapping orphans in a container changes layout and styling, and which container role is right depends on the content.

properties.noFixReason: Wrapping orphans in a container changes layout and styling, and which container role is right depends on the content.

shortDescription.text: A role attribute must contain at least one token that names a WAI-ARIA role authors may use.

fullDescription.text: A role attribute must contain at least one token that names a WAI-ARIA role authors may use. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Correct the role name, or remove the attribute and use an element that already has the meaning. No suggested edit: Passing a list of tokens when one of them is valid is allowed (fallback roles), so a failure means no token is usable and the intended role is unknown.

properties.noFixReason: Passing a list of tokens when one of them is valid is allowed (fallback roles), so a failure means no token is usable and the intended role is unknown.

shortDescription.text: A tab given its role by the role attribute must have an accessible name.

fullDescription.text: A tab given its role by the role attribute must have an accessible name. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Give the tab text, an aria-label or an aria-labelledby. No suggested edit: The name is content: only the author knows what the control is called.

properties.noFixReason: The name is content: only the author knows what the control is called.

shortDescription.text: An element with role="text" must not contain focusable elements.

fullDescription.text: An element with role="text" must not contain focusable elements. A best-practice check that no success criterion requires.

help.text: Move the focusable element out of the role="text" element, or remove the role. No suggested edit: Moving a control or dropping the role changes the page's structure, which is an authoring decision.

properties.noFixReason: Moving a control or dropping the role changes the page's structure, which is an authoring decision.

shortDescription.text: A checkbox, radio button, switch, option or toggling menu item given its role by the role attribute must have an accessible name.

fullDescription.text: A checkbox, radio button, switch, option or toggling menu item given its role by the role attribute must have an accessible name. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Label the control with text, aria-label or aria-labelledby. No suggested edit: The name is content: only the author knows what the control is called.

properties.noFixReason: The name is content: only the author knows what the control is called.

shortDescription.text: A tooltip given its role by the role attribute must have an accessible name.

fullDescription.text: A tooltip given its role by the role attribute must have an accessible name. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Give the tooltip text content, an aria-label or an aria-labelledby. No suggested edit: The name is content: only the author knows what the control is called.

properties.noFixReason: The name is content: only the author knows what the control is called.

shortDescription.text: A tree item given its role by the role attribute should have an accessible name.

fullDescription.text: A tree item given its role by the role attribute should have an accessible name. A best-practice check that no success criterion requires.

help.text: Give the tree item text, an aria-label or an aria-labelledby. No suggested edit: The name is content: only the author knows what the control is called.

properties.noFixReason: The name is content: only the author knows what the control is called.

shortDescription.text: Every attribute that starts with aria- must be a state or property defined by WAI-ARIA.

fullDescription.text: Every attribute that starts with aria- must be a state or property defined by WAI-ARIA. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Fix the spelling of the attribute, or remove it if WAI-ARIA has no such state or property. Suggested edit: Remove the aria- attribute that WAI-ARIA does not define. A browser ignores it, so removing it changes nothing a user perceives.

properties.fix: Remove the aria- attribute that WAI-ARIA does not define. A browser ignores it, so removing it changes nothing a user perceives.

shortDescription.text: Every non-empty WAI-ARIA state or property must have a value of its type, and a required ID reference must name an element in the page.

fullDescription.text: Every non-empty WAI-ARIA state or property must have a value of its type, and a required ID reference must name an element in the page. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Use one of the values WAI-ARIA allows for the attribute, or point the required reference at an element that exists. No suggested edit: The right value depends on what the author meant: a mistyped value, an id that should exist, or an attribute that should go. No single edit is correct for all of them.

properties.noFixReason: The right value depends on what the author meant: a mistyped value, an id that should exist, or an attribute that should go. No single edit is correct for all of them.

shortDescription.text: Audio should have a text alternative.

fullDescription.text: Audio should have a text alternative. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 1.2.1 Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded) (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Provide a transcript or media alternative next to the audio. No suggested edit: Whether captions, transcripts and descriptions exist and are right depends on the recording, which only a person can judge.

properties.noFixReason: Whether captions, transcripts and descriptions exist and are right depends on the recording, which only a person can judge.

shortDescription.text: Audio must have a transcript or another text alternative.

fullDescription.text: Audio must have a transcript or another text alternative. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 1.2.1 Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded) (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Provide a transcript next to the audio, or link to one. No suggested edit: Whether captions, transcripts and descriptions exist and are right depends on the recording, which only a person can judge.

properties.noFixReason: Whether captions, transcripts and descriptions exist and are right depends on the recording, which only a person can judge.

shortDescription.text: The autocomplete attribute of a form field must follow the HTML autofill token syntax.

fullDescription.text: The autocomplete attribute of a form field must follow the HTML autofill token syntax. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose (level AA, WCAG 2.1).

help.text: Change the autocomplete value to the field name that matches the data the field collects, such as email or street-address, optionally preceded by section-*, shipping or billing, and a contact type for telephone and e-mail fields. No suggested edit: Removing a bad value would only hide the problem; the right token depends on what the field collects.

properties.noFixReason: Removing a bad value would only hide the problem; the right token depends on what the field collects.

shortDescription.text: Audio or video that starts by itself with sound must have a way to pause, stop or silence it.

fullDescription.text: Audio or video that starts by itself with sound must have a way to pause, stop or silence it. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 1.4.2 Audio Control (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Add the controls attribute, or put a visible, named pause or mute button on the page. No suggested edit: Adding controls, muting or removing autoplay changes how the media behaves, which is the author's decision.

properties.noFixReason: Adding controls, muting or removing autoplay changes how the media behaves, which is the author's decision.

shortDescription.text: Audio or video that starts by itself should not play sound for more than three seconds.

fullDescription.text: Audio or video that starts by itself should not play sound for more than three seconds. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 1.4.2 Audio Control (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Shorten the sound, mute the media, or do not autoplay it. No suggested edit: Whether captions, transcripts and descriptions exist and are right depends on the recording, which only a person can judge.

properties.noFixReason: Whether captions, transcripts and descriptions exist and are right depends on the recording, which only a person can judge.

shortDescription.text: Line height, letter spacing and word spacing set with !important in a style attribute must already be wide enough for WCAG's text spacing.

fullDescription.text: Line height, letter spacing and word spacing set with !important in a style attribute must already be wide enough for WCAG's text spacing. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 1.4.12 Text Spacing (level AA, WCAG 2.1). Needs rendered facts (layout or painting) for a verdict; without them it reports needs-render.

help.text: Drop !important from the declaration in the style attribute, or make the value at least 1.5 times the font size for line height, 0.12 for letter spacing and 0.16 for word spacing. Suggested edit: Declare the property again in the style attribute without !important. The page keeps its look, and a reader's own style sheet can then adjust the spacing.

properties.fix: Declare the property again in the style attribute without !important. The page keeps its look, and a reader's own style sheet can then adjust the spacing.

shortDescription.text: The blink element makes text flash, which WCAG forbids for more than five seconds.

fullDescription.text: The blink element makes text flash, which WCAG forbids for more than five seconds. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Remove the blink element and mark emphasis another way. No suggested edit: Removing the element drops the author's intended effect, and CSS the library cannot see may style the element, so the author decides what replaces it.

properties.noFixReason: Removing the element drops the author's intended effect, and CSS the library cannot see may style the element, so the author decides what replaces it.

shortDescription.text: A button element must have an accessible name.

fullDescription.text: A button element must have an accessible name. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Put text in the button, or add an aria-label or aria-labelledby. No suggested edit: The name is content: only the author knows what the element is called or shows.

properties.noFixReason: The name is content: only the author knows what the element is called or shows.

shortDescription.text: A page must give a way to skip blocks of content that repeat across pages: a heading, a main landmark or a skip link.

fullDescription.text: A page must give a way to skip blocks of content that repeat across pages: a heading, a main landmark or a skip link. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Add a skip link to the main content, mark it up with a main element, or start it with a heading. No suggested edit: Choosing where the main content starts, and what the skip link says, is the author's decision.

properties.noFixReason: Choosing where the main content starts, and what the skip link says, is the author's decision.

shortDescription.text: Text must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 with its background (3:1 for large text).

fullDescription.text: Text must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 with its background (3:1 for large text). Relevant WCAG success criteria: 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) (level AA, WCAG 2.0). Needs rendered facts (layout or painting) for a verdict; without them it reports needs-render.

help.text: Change the text or background colour until the ratio reaches 4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text. No suggested edit: Colours are a design choice: many pairs would pass, and the right one depends on the brand and the page.

properties.noFixReason: Colours are a design choice: many pairs would pass, and the right one depends on the brand and the page.

shortDescription.text: Text must have a contrast ratio of at least 7:1 with its background (4.5:1 for large text).

fullDescription.text: Text must have a contrast ratio of at least 7:1 with its background (4.5:1 for large text). Relevant WCAG success criteria: 1.4.6 Contrast (Enhanced) (level AAA, WCAG 2.0). Needs rendered facts (layout or painting) for a verdict; without them it reports needs-render.

help.text: Change the text or background colour until the ratio reaches 7:1, or 4.5:1 for large text. No suggested edit: Colours are a design choice: many pairs would pass, and the right one depends on the brand and the page.

properties.noFixReason: Colours are a design choice: many pairs would pass, and the right one depends on the brand and the page.

shortDescription.text: Content must not be rotated by a quarter turn in only one display orientation.

fullDescription.text: Content must not be rotated by a quarter turn in only one display orientation. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 1.3.4 Orientation (level AA, WCAG 2.1).

help.text: Remove the rotation inside the orientation media query, or apply the same rotation in both orientations. No suggested edit: Whether to drop the rotation or rework the layout for the other orientation is a design decision.

properties.noFixReason: Whether to drop the rotation or rework the layout for the other orientation is a design decision.

shortDescription.text: A dl may only directly contain well-ordered dt and dd groups, div, script and template elements.

fullDescription.text: A dl may only directly contain well-ordered dt and dd groups, div, script and template elements. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Order the terms and descriptions as dt then dd, and move other content out of the dl. No suggested edit: Which terms and descriptions belong together is the author's decision.

properties.noFixReason: Which terms and descriptions belong together is the author's decision.

shortDescription.text: A dt or dd element must be inside a dl.

fullDescription.text: A dt or dd element must be inside a dl. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Put the dt and dd elements in a dl. No suggested edit: Whether the content is a definition list at all is the author's decision.

properties.noFixReason: Whether the content is a definition list at all is the author's decision.

shortDescription.text: The document must have a title element with text in it.

fullDescription.text: The document must have a title element with text in it. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 2.4.2 Page Titled (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Add a title element to the head of the document and say in it what the page is. No suggested edit: The title is content: only the author knows what the page is called.

properties.noFixReason: The title is content: only the author knows what the page is called.

shortDescription.text: The title of the page should describe its topic or purpose.

fullDescription.text: The title of the page should describe its topic or purpose. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 2.4.2 Page Titled (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Reword the title element so that it says what the page is for. No suggested edit: Whether a title describes the page is a judgement about content.

properties.noFixReason: Whether a title describes the page is a judgement about content.

shortDescription.text: An id value should be used by one element only.

fullDescription.text: An id value should be used by one element only. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 4.1.1 Parsing (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Give each element its own id. No suggested edit: Which element should keep the id, and what the others are called, is the author's decision; stylesheets and scripts the library cannot see may depend on either.

properties.noFixReason: Which element should keep the id, and what the others are called, is the author's decision; stylesheets and scripts the library cannot see may depend on either.

shortDescription.text: A focusable element must not share its id with another element.

fullDescription.text: A focusable element must not share its id with another element. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 4.1.1 Parsing (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Give each focusable element its own id. No suggested edit: Which element should keep the id, and what the others are called, is the author's decision; stylesheets and scripts the library cannot see may depend on either.

properties.noFixReason: Which element should keep the id, and what the others are called, is the author's decision; stylesheets and scripts the library cannot see may depend on either.

shortDescription.text: An id that a label or an ARIA attribute refers to must be used by one element only.

fullDescription.text: An id that a label or an ARIA attribute refers to must be used by one element only. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Give each element its own id and keep the reference pointing at the right one. No suggested edit: Which element should keep the id, and what the others are called, is the author's decision; stylesheets and scripts the library cannot see may depend on either.

properties.noFixReason: Which element should keep the id, and what the others are called, is the author's decision; stylesheets and scripts the library cannot see may depend on either.

shortDescription.text: The language named by a lang attribute should be the language of the text it covers.

fullDescription.text: The language named by a lang attribute should be the language of the text it covers. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 3.1.2 Language of Parts (level AA, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Read the passage and make its lang attribute name the language the text is written in. No suggested edit: Deciding which language a passage is in needs a reader.

properties.noFixReason: Deciding which language a passage is in needs a reader.

shortDescription.text: A heading must have text.

fullDescription.text: A heading must have text. A best-practice check that no success criterion requires.

help.text: Put text in the heading, or remove the heading element if it is only for spacing. No suggested edit: The name is content: only the author knows what the element is called or shows.

properties.noFixReason: The name is content: only the author knows what the element is called or shows.

shortDescription.text: A table header cell should have text a screen reader can read.

fullDescription.text: A table header cell should have text a screen reader can read. A best-practice check that no success criterion requires.

help.text: Put text in the header cell, or make it a data cell if it does not head anything. No suggested edit: What the header should say is a content decision.

properties.noFixReason: What the header should say is a content decision.

shortDescription.text: An element made focusable with tabindex should have a role that says what it is.

fullDescription.text: An element made focusable with tabindex should have a role that says what it is. A best-practice check that no success criterion requires.

help.text: Give the element a widget, landmark or dialog role, or take it out of the tab order. No suggested edit: Which role fits the element depends on what it does, which only the author knows.

properties.noFixReason: Which role fits the element depends on what it does, which only the author knows.

shortDescription.text: An element that can be reached with the keyboard must show that it has focus.

fullDescription.text: An element that can be reached with the keyboard must show that it has focus. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 2.4.7 Focus Visible (level AA, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Do not remove the browser's focus outline without replacing it; give :focus-visible a visible outline, background or border change. No suggested edit: How the focus should look is a design decision.

properties.noFixReason: How the focus should look is a design decision.

shortDescription.text: A form field should not have more than one label element.

fullDescription.text: A form field should not have more than one label element. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Use one label element for the field and put the extra text inside it. No suggested edit: Which label to keep, or how to merge them, is a content decision.

properties.noFixReason: Which label to keep, or how to merge them, is a content decision.

shortDescription.text: A frame removed from the tab order must not contain focusable content.

fullDescription.text: A frame removed from the tab order must not contain focusable content. Relevant WCAG success criteria: 2.1.1 Keyboard (level A, WCAG 2.0).

help.text: Remove the negative tabindex from the frame, or remove the focusable content. No suggested edit: Whether the frame or its content should change is the author's decision.

properties.noFixReason: Whether the frame or its content should change is the author's decision.

shortDescription.text: A frame or iframe must have an accessible name.
